description: Implement pearl-runtime crate: script runtime adapter contracts and implementations for Rust/Python/PowerShell/Shell backends. Each adapter wraps pearl-process-supervisor to execute scripts with the Article 9 contract (spawn/status/cancel/timeout/cleanup). The adapter layer adds: structured output parsing (JSON stdout contract), environment filtering, timeout enforcement, and exit-code-to-outcome mapping. Reference: daily_rust src/process/mod.rs pattern and the ProcessSupervisor trait already in pearl-process-supervisor.
steps: Create crates/pearl-runtime/Cargo.toml depending on pearl-core, pearl-process-supervisor, serde, serde_json, thiserror, chrono. Use workspace.dependencies.
Add pearl-runtime to workspace members in /projects/sandbox/pearl/Cargo.toml and add pearl-runtime = { path = 'crates/pearl-runtime' } to [workspace.dependencies].
Create crates/pearl-runtime/src/lib.rs with module doc explaining this implements Article 9 runtime contracts and Article 1 script-first execution.

Define RuntimeAdapter trait with methods: execute(script_spec) -> RuntimeResult, validate(script_spec) -> Result<(),ValidationError> (pre-checks the script exists and runtime is available), supports_runtime(Runtime) -> bool.

Define ScriptSpec struct: runtime (Runtime from pearl-governance::manifest), entrypoint (PathBuf), args (Vec<String>), env (BTreeMap<String,String>), cwd (Option<PathBuf>), timeout (TimeDelta), input_payload (Option<serde_json::Value>).

Define RuntimeResult: exit_status (ExitStatus from pearl-process-supervisor), stdout (String), stderr (String), duration (TimeDelta), structured_output (Option<serde_json::Value>) parsed from stdout JSON.

Implement ScriptRuntimeAdapter that wraps PlatformSupervisor and handles: (1) building CommandSpec from ScriptSpec (choosing python3/pwsh/bash/the binary based on Runtime), (2) optionally piping input_payload as a temp file or env var, (3) collecting stdout/stderr after process completes, (4) attempting JSON parse of stdout for structured_output.
Implement runtime-specific program resolution: Python -> 'python3', PowerShell -> 'pwsh', Shell -> 'bash' or 'sh', Rust -> direct binary path from entrypoint, Native -> direct binary.

Write tests: test that ScriptSpec builds correct CommandSpec for each runtime type, test JSON stdout parsing, test timeout handling logic, test that RuntimeResult correctly reports success/failure. Use mock/unit tests (not actual process spawning for most tests).
Ensure cargo test --workspace passes, clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean.
acceptance_criteria: ScriptRuntimeAdapter correctly maps Runtime::Python to 'python3' command
RuntimeResult parses JSON stdout into structured_output
